traces.name: ext_extreme_continuous_100
traces.note: u64-extreme token amounts: T + B at the u64 ceiling (deposits refused with overflow), huge share counts, deep rebases

traces.name: ext_extreme_continuous_90
traces.note: u64-extreme token amounts, 90 % cap, lumps up to 1,000 SOL

traces.name: ext_scripted_lock_terms
traces.note: scripted, ARCH §9 M0b note (1): lock terms at the u128 ceiling while Pi is 1; an overflowing term refuses the withdrawal (C0-9, V2-3)

traces.name: ext_scripted_no_shares
traces.note: scripted, ARCH §9 M0b note (4): S = 0 while B_Q > 0 after a dust exit; rent credited to the protocol sink takes lender SOL (pool_model.check() fails on the listed lines) and the close's true-up is refused while S = 0

traces.name: ext_scripted_overlock
traces.note: scripted, ARCH §9 M0b note (2): locks kept on almost every share after the borrowed tokens returned (V2-3); v0.4.1's floored terms keep the allowances within T

traces.name: ext_scripted_empty_lock_term
traces.note: scripted, M0b review M0B-A-1: an empty lender (shares and lock floored to 0 by a rebase, lock term 1) reads the next roll's record, which scales its term to 0, before the V2-12 jump
